notes.title: BOWLOUT Launched this week
notes.content:
Hi pins!
After a long wait, BOWLOUT has finally released, and we couldn't be happier! The game was originally going to be a school-project collaboration between Quint and I, but development went so well that we were able to turn it into a complete game!

For the both of us, releasing our own game on Steam was something we never considered to be possible, but simply going for it did the trick! It was really cool to make a game for paying customers for the first time - it made us focus on making the game more accessible, polished, and complete. This is why we chose for the game to be simpler and shorter; we prevented padding or overscaling the game. Lots of indies fail to reach the finish line because there's always more to add.


How's it doing?
For a short and simple game without a marketing budget, we had relatively low sales expectations, but we're happy to report we've just passed 100 sales! We really appreciate every person playing the game and have read every review so far! Our main takeaways are that, while players find the game very short, they are having a good time and appreciate the effort put into the polishing and additional features (settings, achievements, unlockables).

If you liked the game, please consider leaving a review! It will help BOWLOUT reach more people! You can also recommend it to friends or your favorite content creator. We'd be happy to help!


Again, thank you to everyone who purchased the game!
If you have any questions about the game, don't hesitate to contact us!

- Sep

notes.title: Alpha Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!

ALPHA LIVE NOW!
The pre-alpha testing is now live!
You can request and sign up on the store page! 
It will be open for the first few days and after that there will be waves of access given out.

note this is a week old build which was the latest version on our itch.io page

Feedback
With this pre-alpha testing we hope you can give us some use full feedback! 
The easiest way to do this is by joining our discord channel, here you can give us feedback directly.
there will also be google doc forum that will be posted after every updated!

Updates
Later this week we will have a big update! with lots of changes and new things ːsteamhappyː.
After that we will be updating the game every 2 weeks, these will mostly contain small changes that we made based on your feedback!

Thank you in advance for testing our game!! ːsteamhappyː
